items_flat.title_en: OpenAI introduces GPT-6.1 Terra for fast, lower-cost computer use
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，提供更快速低成本的電腦操作能力
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast efficient model that advances visual reasoning, precise computer use, and natural writing over GPT-5.6 Terra. Standard API prices are 50% lower ($1/$5 per million input/output tokens); it is available in ChatGPT Work and Codex for Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu users and via the API as gpt-6.1-terra. OpenAI reports strong gains on Agents’ Last Exam and lower error rates versus the prior Terra model.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，在視覺推理、精準電腦操作與自然寫作上較 GPT-5.6 Terra 有所進步。標準 API 價格降低 50%（每百萬輸入／輸出 token 為 $1/$5），已開放給 Plus/Pro/Enterprise/Edu 用戶在 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 使用，並透過 API 以 gpt-6.1-terra 提供。OpenAI 稱其在 Agents’ Last Exam 上明顯優於前代，且錯誤率下降。
items_flat.analysis_en: Terra fills a practical mid-tier slot for high-volume agentic and desktop tasks at sharply lower cost and latency than flagship models. Independent benchmarks and real-world reliability of the claimed speed and accuracy gains remain to be confirmed outside OpenAI’s internal evaluations.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Terra 填補了高用量代理與桌面任務的實用中階定位，成本與延遲遠低於旗艦模型。其宣稱的速度與準確度提升仍有待外部獨立基準與實際使用驗證。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing GPT-6.1 Terra, a fast, efficient model that combines detailed visual reasoning and precise computer use alongside clearer, more natural writing.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 GPT-6.1 Terra，一款結合詳細視覺推理、精準電腦操作以及更清晰自然寫作的快速高效模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代碼在 Nasdaq 上市
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. The prospectus shows first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion alongside a large net loss driven mainly by non-cash items.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 向 SEC 提交 Form S-1，擬公開發行 Class A 普通股並在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 以 ANT 代碼上市。股數與價格區間尚未確定。招股說明書顯示 2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元，同時有主要由非現金項目造成的大額淨虧損。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive revenue growth with continued losses remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 在先前保密申報後邁向公開上市的第一步。目標估值、時程，以及市場如何權衡爆發性營收成長與持續虧損，仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 向美國證券交易委員會提交 Form S-1 註冊聲明，涉及其 Class A 普通股的擬議首次公開發行。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI shares AI-generated results on math, complexity, and physics with academic groups
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與學術團體分享數學、複雜度與物理領域的 AI 生成結果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that internal models produced results in mathematics (proof of the local smoothing conjecture resolving Kakeya and Stein restriction conjectures in all dimensions), computer science (disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis), and physics (existence proofs related to quantum field theories including QCD). It is releasing materials under different community-led strategies and publishing some Lean formalizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布內部模型產生數學（證明 local smoothing 猜想，從而解決所有維度的 Kakeya 與 Stein restriction 猜想）、電腦科學（反證 Exponential Time Hypothesis）與物理（與 QCD 等量子場論存在性相關的證明）結果。它正以不同的社群主導策略釋出材料，並公開部分 Lean 形式化證明。
items_flat.analysis_en: If independently verified, the results would mark a notable instance of frontier models contributing to longstanding open problems. The staggered, community-led release approach acknowledges verification challenges but also creates temporary information asymmetries.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若經獨立驗證，這些結果將標誌前沿模型對長期未解問題做出顯著貢獻。分階段、由社群主導的釋出方式承認驗證困難，但也暫時造成資訊不對稱。
items_flat.quote: We are announcing three new discoveries in mathematics, computer science, and physics about harmonic analysis, complexity theory, and quantum field theory.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們宣布在數學、電腦科學與物理領域關於調和分析、複雜度理論與量子場論的三項新發現。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI makes Decisions API generally available with GPT-6 Luna
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將搭配 GPT-6 Luna 的 Decisions API 正式全面開放
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI made the Decisions API generally available, built with GPT-6 Luna, for fast, low-cost structured decisions from text, images, and JSON. It supports up to 400 questions per request, prompt caching, and native GPT-Live integration.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 將以 GPT-6 Luna 打造的 Decisions API 正式全面開放，可用於從文字、影像與 JSON 快速且低成本地產生結構化決策。它支援每次請求最多 400 個問題、提示快取，以及原生 GPT-Live 整合。
items_flat.analysis_en: The API targets high-volume routing and classification inside agents and apps, trading some generality for latency and cost. Early customer reports cite multi-x speedups versus the Responses API, but broader production reliability data is still limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此 API 針對代理與應用內的高用量路由與分類，以部分通用性換取延遲與成本優勢。早期客戶回報相對 Responses API 有數倍加速，但更廣泛的生產環境可靠性數據仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re making the Decisions API generally available. Built with GPT‑6 Luna, the Decisions API focuses Luna’s intelligence on questions with bounded answers, helping applications and agents make near real-time decisions from text, images, and structured inputs up to 10x faster than GPT‑6 Luna through the Responses API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Decisions API 全面開放。基於 GPT‑6 Luna，Decisions API 將 Luna 的智能聚焦於有界答案的問題，協助應用與代理從文字、圖像與結構化輸入做出近即時決策，速度最高可達透過 Responses API 的 GPT‑6 Luna 的 10 倍。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details hardened containment for frontier model training
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述前沿模型訓練的強化隔離措施
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published how it strengthened research environments for frontier-model training and evaluation, implementing no-internet access for training, defense-in-depth isolation, and large-scale red-teaming with its own models. It resumed RL training after the changes.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布如何強化前沿模型訓練與評估的研究環境，實施訓練無網路存取、縱深防禦隔離，以及以自身模型進行大規模紅隊測試。變更後已恢復 RL 訓練。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post shows concrete operational responses to model containment risks, including offline web caches and microVM isolation. Whether these measures scale as models grow more capable remains an open question for the industry.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此文展示對模型隔離風險的具體操作回應，包括離線網頁快取與 microVM 隔離。這些措施能否隨模型能力提升而擴展，仍是產業開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
items_flat.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 釋出 ChatGPT Signals 跨國工作活動數據
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and how usage has broadened over time.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 經濟研究團隊釋出彙總的 ChatGPT Signals 數據，涵蓋近 100 國、從 2025 年 Q1 至 2026 年 Q3 的 165 項中間工作活動。數據可供研究者分析消費者如何用 ChatGPT 處理工作任務，以及使用範圍如何隨時間擴大。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise and Codex usage, so the picture is incomplete.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此等粒度的公開隱私保護使用數據在前沿實驗室中並不常見，有助獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業與 Codex 使用，因此整體圖像並不完整。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 標準捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the original release.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 開放標準（以 SKILL.md 資料夾存放專門代理知識）捐贈給 Linux Foundation 旗下的 Agentic AI Foundation。自原始釋出以來，包括 ChatGPT、Cursor 與 VS Code 在內的超過 70 個平台已整合該標準。
items_flat.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend the format.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可降低單一廠商控制，並支持更廣泛的代理互通性。採用程度將取決於其他實驗室與平台實施及擴展該格式的速度。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

items_flat.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路
items_flat.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations; more than 130 companies joined during early access.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，供企業以 Grok 打造產品與服務。包括負責企業部署的 Transformation Partners 與負責外掛與整合的 Marketplace Partners；早期存取階段已有超過 130 家公司加入。
items_flat.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption beyond early-access interest.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫在 xAI 進一步與 SpaceX 整合之際，將 Grok 的通路策略正式化。成功與否取決於合作夥伴品質，以及該網路能否將早期興趣轉化為可衡量的企業採用。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 模型即將登陸 Google Cloud
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models; general availability is planned in the coming weeks.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布其模型即將登陸 Google Cloud，在現有合作夥伴之外擴大分發。公司持續協調提供其模型的各供應商安全標準；全面可用預計在未來數週內。
items_flat.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and data residency will determine how widely enterprises adopt the option.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性提升企業觸及範圍，但也提高跨託管環境一致防護措施的重要性。確切模型、定價與資料駐留細節將決定企業採用的廣度。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 合作開發 AI 原生工程工作流程
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by the end of October.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 宣布合作，將包括 Large 4 在內的 Mistral 模型與 NVIDIA 加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4 權重仍計畫於十月底釋出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the open ecosystem.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此合作針對領域特定的工業用例而非一般對話。Large 4 開放權重的釋出將是開放生態系統近期更重要的發展。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述服務超過 10 億 ChatGPT 用戶的儲存擴展
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布其工程系列關於 Habitat 的第二部分，Habitat 是服務 ChatGPT 及其他產品的線上儲存平台。文章聚焦於優化 Azure Cosmos DB，以處理橫跨 40 個區域超過 500 PB 的成長。
items_flat.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering investment behind continued growth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此類基礎設施文章是少數公開展示服務前沿 AI 產品所需營運規模的窗口。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示持續成長背後的工程投入。

openai.quote: Based on the current state of alignment research, monitoring systems, and the security of internet infrastructure, we believe the responsible approach is to conduct frontier model training with no internet access. We’ve implemented this policy and will maintain it until advances in these safeguards justify broader internet access.
openai.quote_zh: 基於目前對齊研究、監控系統與網路基礎設施安全的狀態，我們認為負責任的做法是在無網路存取的情況下進行前線模型訓練。我們已實施此政策，並將維持至這些防護措施的進展足以證明更廣泛網路存取的合理性為止。

openai.title_en: OpenAI releases ChatGPT Signals data on work activities across countries
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 釋出 ChatGPT Signals 跨國工作活動數據
openai.summary_en: OpenAI Economic Research released aggregated ChatGPT Signals data covering 165 Intermediate Work Activities across nearly 100 countries from Q1 2025 to Q3 2026. The data lets researchers study how consumers use ChatGPT for work tasks and how usage has broadened over time.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 經濟研究團隊釋出彙總的 ChatGPT Signals 數據，涵蓋近 100 國、從 2025 年 Q1 至 2026 年 Q3 的 165 項中間工作活動。數據可供研究者分析消費者如何用 ChatGPT 處理工作任務，以及使用範圍如何隨時間擴大。
openai.analysis_en: Public, privacy-preserving usage data of this granularity is uncommon from frontier labs and can support independent economic research. Limitations include exclusion of enterprise and Codex usage, so the picture is incomplete.
openai.analysis_zh: 此等粒度的公開隱私保護使用數據在前沿實驗室中並不常見，有助獨立經濟研究。限制包括排除企業與 Codex 使用，因此整體圖像並不完整。
openai.quote: Today, we are releasing OpenAI Signals data that explores 165 work activities across nearly 100 countries, revealing how consumers use ChatGPT for work.
openai.quote_zh: 今日，我們發布 OpenAI Signals 數據，探討近 100 個國家的 165 項工作活動，揭示消費者如何以 ChatGPT 處理工作。

openai.title_en: OpenAI models become available on Google Cloud
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 模型即將登陸 Google Cloud
openai.summary_en: OpenAI announced that its models are coming to Google Cloud, expanding distribution alongside existing partnerships. The company continues aligning safety standards across providers that offer its models; general availability is planned in the coming weeks.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣布其模型即將登陸 Google Cloud，在現有合作夥伴之外擴大分發。公司持續協調提供其模型的各供應商安全標準；全面可用預計在未來數週內。
openai.analysis_en: Broader cloud availability increases enterprise reach but also raises the importance of consistent safeguards across different hosting environments. Details on exact models, pricing, and data residency will determine how widely enterprises adopt the option.
openai.analysis_zh: 更廣泛的雲端可用性提升企業觸及範圍，但也提高跨託管環境一致防護措施的重要性。確切模型、定價與資料駐留細節將決定企業採用的廣度。

openai.title_en: OpenAI details storage scaling for over 1 billion ChatGPT users
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 詳述服務超過 10 億 ChatGPT 用戶的儲存擴展
openai.summary_en: OpenAI published Part II of its engineering series on Habitat, the online storage platform that serves ChatGPT and other products. The post focuses on optimizing Azure Cosmos DB to handle growth to over 500 petabytes across 40 regions.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布其工程系列關於 Habitat 的第二部分，Habitat 是服務 ChatGPT 及其他產品的線上儲存平台。文章聚焦於優化 Azure Cosmos DB，以處理橫跨 40 個區域超過 500 PB 的成長。
openai.analysis_en: Infrastructure posts of this kind are rare public windows into the operational scale required to serve frontier AI products. They rarely change product capabilities directly but signal the engineering investment behind continued growth.
openai.analysis_zh: 此類基礎設施文章是少數公開展示服務前沿 AI 產品所需營運規模的窗口。它們很少直接改變產品能力，但顯示持續成長背後的工程投入。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic files S-1 for proposed Nasdaq IPO under ticker ANT
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代碼在 Nasdaq 上市
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic filed Form S-1 with the SEC for a proposed IPO of Class A common stock, intending to list on Nasdaq Global Select Market under ANT. Share count and price range are not yet set. The prospectus shows first-half 2026 revenue of about $16.3 billion alongside a large net loss driven mainly by non-cash items.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 向 SEC 提交 Form S-1，擬公開發行 Class A 普通股並在 Nasdaq Global Select Market 以 ANT 代碼上市。股數與價格區間尚未確定。招股說明書顯示 2026 上半年營收約 163 億美元，同時有主要由非現金項目造成的大額淨虧損。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is the first public step toward Anthropic becoming a listed company after earlier confidential filings. Valuation targets, timing, and how markets weigh the combination of explosive revenue growth with continued losses remain open questions.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是 Anthropic 在先前保密申報後邁向公開上市的第一步。目標估值、時程，以及市場如何權衡爆發性營收成長與持續虧損，仍是開放問題。
anthropic.quote: Today, Anthropic, PBC filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission relating to its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
anthropic.quote_zh: 今日，Anthropic, PBC 向美國證券交易委員會提交 Form S-1 註冊聲明，涉及其 Class A 普通股的擬議首次公開發行。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic donates Agent Skills standard to Agentic AI Foundation
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 標準捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic donated the Agent Skills open standard (SKILL.md folders for specialized agent knowledge) to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 platforms including ChatGPT, Cursor, and VS Code have integrated it since the original release.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 開放標準（以 SKILL.md 資料夾存放專門代理知識）捐贈給 Linux Foundation 旗下的 Agentic AI Foundation。自原始釋出以來，包括 ChatGPT、Cursor 與 VS Code 在內的超過 70 個平台已整合該標準。
anthropic.analysis_en: Moving the standard to a neutral foundation reduces single-vendor control and supports broader agent interoperability. Adoption will depend on how quickly other labs and platforms implement and extend the format.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 將標準移至中立基金會可降低單一廠商控制，並支持更廣泛的代理互通性。採用程度將取決於其他實驗室與平台實施及擴展該格式的速度。
anthropic.quote: Today, we’re donating Agent Skills, the open standard that gives AI agents specialized knowledge and workflows, to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF).
anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們將 Agent Skills（賦予 AI 代理專業知識與工作流程的開放標準）捐贈給 Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF)。

xai.title_en: xAI introduces SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network
xai.title_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路
xai.summary_en: xAI launched the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network for companies building products and services with Grok. It includes Transformation Partners for enterprise deployment and Marketplace Partners for plugins and integrations; more than 130 companies joined during early access.
xai.summary_zh: xAI 推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，供企業以 Grok 打造產品與服務。包括負責企業部署的 Transformation Partners 與負責外掛與整合的 Marketplace Partners；早期存取階段已有超過 130 家公司加入。
xai.analysis_en: The program formalizes a channel strategy around Grok as xAI integrates further with SpaceX. Success will depend on partner quality and whether the network drives measurable enterprise adoption beyond early-access interest.
xai.analysis_zh: 此計畫在 xAI 進一步與 SpaceX 整合之際，將 Grok 的通路策略正式化。成功與否取決於合作夥伴品質，以及該網路能否將早期興趣轉化為可衡量的企業採用。
xai.quote: Today, we’re introducing the SpaceX Super Intelligence Partner Network, our official program for companies building products, solutions, and services with Grok for our joint prospects and customers.
xai.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 SpaceX Super Intelligence 合作夥伴網路，這是我們的官方計畫，供以 Grok 為共同潛在客戶與客戶建置產品、解決方案與服務的公司使用。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral and NVIDIA collaborate on AI-native engineering workflows
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 合作開發 AI 原生工程工作流程
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral and NVIDIA announced collaboration to integrate Mistral models, including Large 4, with NVIDIA accelerated computing and physics tools for faster engineering simulations and closed-loop design. Large 4 weights remain planned for release by the end of October.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 與 NVIDIA 宣布合作，將包括 Large 4 在內的 Mistral 模型與 NVIDIA 加速運算及物理工具整合，以加速工程模擬與閉環設計。Large 4 權重仍計畫於十月底釋出。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The partnership targets domain-specific industrial use cases rather than general chat. Open-weight release of Large 4 would be the more consequential near-term development for the open ecosystem.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 此合作針對領域特定的工業用例而非一般對話。Large 4 開放權重的釋出將是開放生態系統近期更重要的發展。

brief_en: OpenAI shipped GPT-6.1 Terra, a faster cheaper mid-tier model strong at computer use and visual tasks. Anthropic filed its public S-1 for a Nasdaq IPO under ANT. OpenAI also shared AI-generated math, complexity, and physics results with academic groups for independent verification.
brief_zh: OpenAI 推出更快速便宜的 GPT-6.1 Terra，強化電腦操作與視覺推理。Anthropic 公開提交 S-1，擬以 ANT 代碼在 Nasdaq 上市。OpenAI 亦與學術社群分享數學、複雜度與物理領域的 AI 生成結果。
